The purpose is to confirm that the degree has been completed — this permit is for graduates, not for people still enrolled, so it is not a requirement to maintain student status. Because this permit is a renewal of a student residence permit, you must also show that you previously held one in Iceland.
修法同一批还收紧了在读者的学业进度要求：续签时须证明完成全日制课业的至少 75%: The same legislative change also tightened academic progress requirements for people still studying: on renewal you must show completion of at least 75% of a full-time course load during the academic year, and this is now checked at every renewal rather than only at the first one. That does not directly govern the post-graduation permit, but it affects whether you can keep renewing your student permit long enough to graduate — and holding a student residence permit until graduation is the precondition for this permit.
